method: Automated discovery from GDELT and Google News, restricted to allowlisted official and credible public sources. Exercise intake explicitly covers Active, Reserve and National Guard reporting and does not infer a component when the public source is ambiguous. Safety intake combines daily recent-report discovery, a weekly five-year backfill and pinned official records for major events; casualty values remain unknown unless reported.
